## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests)
- [ ] Tokens only: no hex outside `tokens.css`, no inline styles, no literal font size under 14px
- [ ] Every new visible string is in `src/i18n/dict.ts` in Thai and English
- [ ] New or changed component: keyboard works, a test covers it, `docs/components/` is updated
- [ ] Looked at it in light and dark, and with reduced motion
